motivation: R2 materially reduced errors by matching the source-law variable S in the wet region, but all six stress materials still failed. R3 keeps the R2 physical axis and storage exactly unchanged and tests whether the remaining limitation is the second-order bilinear interpolation of the two-dimensional log-mobility surface.

unchanged_candidate.wet_coordinate: uniform S from S(h=-1) to S_thr=S(h=-2)

r3_change_only.interpolation: tensor product of two local four-point cubic Lagrange interpolants in analytic index coordinates
r3_change_only.arithmetic_type: float64 after reading float32 table values

regime_local_stencil_contract.classification: S >= S_thr uses the wet regime, S < S_thr uses the dry regime; S==S_thr is exactly x=18 and uses a wet one-sided stencil
regime_local_stencil_contract.endpoint_policy: one-sided four-point cubic stencil inside the same regime
regime_local_stencil_contract.node_reproduction: At an exact table-node coordinate the cubic Lagrange interpolant must reproduce that stored table value exactly up to float64 arithmetic.

structural_physics_guards.flux_sign: q=g*exp(logM_interp), so interpolated mobility remains strictly positive for finite logM and the flux sign remains the sign of driving head g
structural_physics_guards.equal_head: equal-head path continues to bypass the table and returns source-bound K(h) exactly
structural_physics_guards.mass_ledger: unchanged; table only approximates face flux
structural_physics_guards.finite_guard: non-finite or overflowed cubic logM/exp is a hard lookup failure, never clipped

characterization.probe_set: reuse the frozen C2A development characterization probes

exit_rule.pass_all_six: freeze R3 unchanged and create a fresh 36-material KSATEXM holdout before any C2A catalog qualification claim
exit_rule.any_fail: reject R3 fail-closed. Do not increase interpolation order or density automatically. Diagnose residual error topology and reconsider stored quantity or an analytic wet-end correction before another candidate.

scope_guard: No h>-1 cm, no non-zero H_ENPR, no saturation switching, no heterogeneous profiles, no timestep qualification, no bottom boundary, no groundwater, no MultiSWAP production claim, no J1 response tangent and no FullRichards equivalence.
